documents_expected.why: Round 50 guidelines and bid instructions: eligibility, match, checklist, reporting, deadline

eligibility.rule: NY 501(c)(3) nonprofits, governments, municipalities, tribes, SWCDs, school districts, universities
eligibility.quote: the following entities are considered eligible bidders: 501(c)(3) not-for-profit corporations, Governmental Entities, Municipalities, and Quasi-Governmental Entities

eligibility.rule: Nonprofits incorporated in New York and current on charities reporting
eligibility.quote: has filed a Certificate of Incorporation to be incorporated in New York State and is current in their charities reporting requirements with the Office of the Attorney General.

eligibility.rule: Nonprofits prequalified in SFS Grants Management by the due date
eligibility.quote: A not-for-profit organization must also be prequalified in SFS Grants Management by the bid due date to be determined eligible under this grant opportunity.
alt_quotes: All Bidders must be Prequalified in the SFS Grants Management System at the time and date that the bid is due.

eligibility.rule: Individuals and unincorporated groups only through a fiscal sponsor
eligibility.quote: Individuals and unincorporated groups are not eligible for this grant opportunity. However, an eligible bidder may apply on behalf of an individual or unincorporated group as a fiscal sponsor.

eligibility.rule: Project in the Hudson River Estuary watershed, on a perennial stream
eligibility.quote: Eligible projects for grant funding must be located within defined geographic boundaries of the Hudson River Estuary watershed
alt_quotes: The project must be located on a perennial stream.

eligibility.rule: Own the site or have the landowner's permission
eligibility.quote: Proof of ownership or permission for work to be conducted on the property is required for ALL projects.
can be completed and invoiced within a three-year contract period/term of September 1, 2027 through August 31, 2030.

eligibility.rule: Up to two bids, not for the same project
eligibility.quote: Bidders may submit up to two (2) Bids. Multiple bids may not be for the same project or project location.

documents.quote: The Bid Application Form is completed in full and is uploaded in SFS.

documents.item: Location map, GPS coordinates and site photos
documents.quote: The bidder must provide GPS coordinates of the subject barrier(s), and a map and photos of the current location and condition of the site, uploaded to SFS Grants Management.
alt_quotes: Pictures of the site that establish the current conditions.

documents.quote: A project timeline, showing project start date of September 1, 2027 with a completion date of August 31, 2030.
The expenditure-based budget is completed, including justifications for all budget items.

documents.item: Work plan with objectives, tasks and performance measures
documents.quote: The work plan is provided with clear objectives, tasks, and performance measures.

documents.item: Match worksheet listing all match sources
documents.quote: Bidders will be required to provide the sources of all matching funds using the Match Worksheet in SFS Grants Management.

documents.item: Proof of property ownership or landowner permission
documents.quote: Proof of property ownership or landowner permission must be provided as an upload to the Bid
Letters substantiating the collaboration from each partner are required.

documents.item: Sexual harassment, Executive Order 16 and gender-based violence certifications
documents.quote: The required certification for sexual harassment prevention is uploaded.
alt_quotes: The required certification for Executive Order 16 is uploaded.
The required certification for Gender-Based Violence and the Workplace is uploaded.

documents.item: QAPP worksheet and completed bid checklist
alt_quotes: This Bid Checklist is completed and uploaded.

effort.step: Register and prequalify in SFS Grants Management (allow 5 days for review)
effort.quote: THE STATE RESERVES 5 DAYS TO REVIEW SUBMITTED PREQUALIFICATION BIDS.
Questions regarding this grant opportunity will be accepted by the DEC until C.O.B. December 10, 2026.

effort.step: Submit the bid in the SFS Vendor Portal
effort.quote: Bid Due Date: December 17, 2026, by 3:00 p.m. ET

co_finance_required.quote: For this grant opportunity, Bidders must match at least 10% of the grant funding amount.

after_award.quote: Quarterly Narrative Reports must be submitted in narrative form, no later than 30 days from the end of the calendar quarter.
alt_quotes: The Contractor must submit the Final Report no later than 60 days after the end of the contract period.

notes: Awards $10,500–$200,000 from about $400,000. Match is 10% of the grant amount (not of project cost) and can't come from other state or federal funds; 15% or more scores extra points. Crossing replacements must pass a 100-year storm. Dam-removal planning needs initial reconnaissance documentation. Projects start with a kick-off with Estuary Program staff.
